_readme: Which script each language wrote and when (scripts/build-script-history.js): per language, dated events, each a script line (the stage where it was taken up) with the modern stage down its branch (tip), the reason (own, rule, religion, state, family, neighbour), whose script it was (via) and how strong the reason; the stage in force in a year is found along the line (use.js stageInForce). Switches are the replacements proposed for DJ’s veto (data/history/script-vetoes.json). Religion dates are DJ’s (29 Oct 2026).

Tzinalli.note: the Arten glyphs of Areoix Lie

Kallimethra.note: many scripts, as Christianity: whichever script the people who brought the faith wrote

Imarel.note: the Quian letters, each land in the nearest sister

Kelhari.note: the Alzurian abjad and the scripts grown from it

Srivandha.note: the Sakernlesi script, its old rulers'

users.note: Hadan uses the Lycroan script (DJ, 30 Oct 2026)
Lastnu writes with the script of southern Ayuma (DJ, 28 Oct 2026)
